settings.title: Measure in the morning
settings.text: Measure first thing in the morning, with the tape snug, not tight.

settings.title: Ankle (B): this sets your size
settings.text: Measure just above the ankle bone, at the narrowest point. Keep the tape snug, not tight.

settings.title: Calf (C): a fit check
settings.text: Sitting with your foot flat, measure around the fullest part of the calf.

settings.title: Knee-high length
settings.text: Vital Socks are knee-high and end just under the knee.

settings.heading: Designed around your leg.
settings.text: Our socks are sized using ankle circumference, rather than relying only on shoe size, helping you choose a fit suited to your leg.
settings.sample_notice: Sample sizing shown. The final Vital Socks size chart is on its way.
